role: Populate reference: ChunkProviderServer.populate for every chunk of a W x W raw region (overworld, nether or end), recorded call by call: biome, structure-map sizes and intersecting starts, chunk loads, populate Random seed at each stage marker, every block write, tile entity deltas, spawned entities, then pending ticks and the final region. Also a scan command that picks regions covering every biome.
notes: Hooks: PopulateProbe.mark(stage, rand) stage markers in the decorators and chunk providers; PopulateProbe.onChunkLoaded in ChunkProviderServer.loadChunk. csrc/engine/populate.h, populate_nether.h and decorator.h cite it.
